themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Covers platforms and tools designed to facilitate and enhance AI-driven research processes, often integrating multiple AI capabilities.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI's application in analyzing user sentiment, reviews, and qualitative feedback.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI is integrated into the design process for products and user experiences, as well as research methodologies.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behaviors, capabilities, and impacts of AI chatbots, particularly in user interactions and research contexts.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in automating or enhancing the process of testing product usability.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
